name: Podman Desktop
description: 自由开源的无根 (Rootless) 容器与 Kubernetes 管理平台，替代商业 Docker。
description_en: Podman Desktop is the best free and open source tool to work with Containers and Kubernetes for developers. Get an intuitive and user-friendly interface to effortlessly build, manage, and deploy containers and Kubernetes — all from your desktop.
